system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Legendary[1], Salt. 1 item slot (Worn). Attunement. Special Property: Goldstore.

Prerequisites: You are a family member of the Myrgha Oligarchy, Proficiency[5], Heavy Armor Proficiency

A thinly laced weave of golden fabric supports a suit of armor, deeply and ornately detailed in the gaudy fashion of the Myrgha. This armor is extremely thin, and designed to be worn beneath robes or other clothes by a Goldbound warrior. It is emblazoned with your family crest.

Goldweave Armor (Passive): Using this armor provides a baseline effect of +5AD, 2 Adornment Slots, 0 Trinket Slots, and 0 Additional RIS. The armor is inherently worth 2,000gp that cannot be consumed through Goldbinder abilities (but can be sold if the armor is destroyed and melted down). If you are a Goldbinder Fatebound, you can take Goldshield and Goldenhoard when you are attuned to this item.

Rulebook p.34.
